source: Pew Research Center. American Trends Panel Wave 117, fielded November 16-27, 2022.
method: Population is respondent's religious tradition (F_RELTRAD) among social media users (SNSUSE_W117 = "yes"). Share answering "yes" to LEADERFOLLOW2_W117 ("Do you follow or keep track of your own religious leaders online or on social media?"); refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted (Orthodox Christian falls below this floor at the social-media-user screen). Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT_W117 variable.
